description: End-to-end task evals for remapping Lynx main-thread function_id:pc_index positions using debug-info.json.

evals.name: remap-main-thread-frame
evals.prompt: Lynx 报错里有一帧 `at App (file:///main-thread.js:1356:13)`，项目路径是 `/repo/app`，`debug-info.json` 在 `/repo/app/dist/.rspeedy/main/debug-info.json`。请告诉我应该运行哪条 remapping 命令，并说明输出如何用于替换 stack trace。
evals.expected_output: A command invoking the skill script with debug-info path, function id `1356`, and pc index `13`, plus an explanation that the output line:column replaces `main-thread.js:1356:13`.
expectations: The command uses `node` to run the skill's `scripts/index.mjs` remapping script.
The command passes `/repo/app/dist/.rspeedy/main/debug-info.json` as the debug info path.
The command passes `1356` as the function id and `13` as the pc index.
The answer explains that the script output is a source `line:column` pair.
The answer says the remapped position should replace the encoded `main-thread.js:1356:13` stack frame.

evals.name: ask-for-missing-debug-info
evals.prompt: 我只有这个错误：`main-thread.js exception at App (file:///main-thread.js:1002:12)`，还没给你 `debug-info.json`。你应该怎么继续？
evals.expected_output: A response that identifies the function_id:pc_index pair, confirms it is a main-thread frame, and asks for the corresponding debug-info.json path before running the script.
expectations: The response extracts `1002:12` as the function_id:pc_index pair.
The response confirms this is a main-thread stack frame and therefore needs remapping.
The response asks the user for the corresponding `debug-info.json` path.
The response suggests the usual rspeedy location `dist/.rspeedy/main/debug-info.json` as a likely place.
The response does not claim it can remap without debug info.

evals.name: skip-background-stack
evals.prompt: 这段报错来自 background JS：`background.js exception at doWork (file:///background.js:90:7)`。我需要用 debug-info remap 吗？
evals.expected_output: A response saying the skill targets main-thread encoded `main-thread.js` frames, while a background stack generally does not need this debug-info remapping workflow.
expectations: The response says this remapping workflow is for main-thread encoded stacks.
The response points out that the given frame is `background.js`, not `main-thread.js`.
The response says debug-info remapping is generally not needed for that background stack.
The response suggests using normal source map or background debugging context if further investigation is needed.
